Definition: Whether the country has an operational Internet Exchange Point (IXP) and its maturity. IXPs enable local internet traffic to be exchanged domestically rather than being routed internationally, reducing latency, costs, and dependence on foreign infrastructure. Critical for local digital ecosystem development.
redteam_note: Scored >0 but NO source cited — unsupported claim, verify first.
revision_notes: No source was originally cited. PCH/PeeringDB confirm no operational IXP is currently listed for Guinea-Bissau, but the Guinea-Bissau Internet Exchange Point Association (GwIX) was formally constituted in May 2025 with an elected president and a stated priority to 'deploy Guinea-Bissau's first IXP', and an AU PIDA project record shows a national IXP project at construction stage. This is active development rather than complete absence, so revised from 1 (No IXP) to 2 (IXP planned or under development).

Definition: The availability and presence of major cloud service providers (hyperscale and regional) operating in or serving the country with local or near-local infrastructure. Cloud availability determines access to scalable computing resources for government, business, and startups.
Value Name: Served remotely from distant regions only (>100ms latency)
redteam_note: Scored >0 but NO source cited — unsupported claim, verify first.
revision_notes: No source was originally cited. A 2025 West Africa data-centre market brief and AWS/Azure region documentation confirm that as of early 2025 West Africa had no public cloud region from any top-5 hyperscaler (Huawei Cloud Nigeria, opened late 2024, is the only regional exception), and the nearest AWS/Azure regions to Guinea-Bissau remain in South Africa or Europe. No Guinea-Bissau-specific source exists, but this regional evidence supports 'served remotely from distant regions only' — score of 2 confirmed, unchanged.

Definition: The presence and tier quality of commercial/colocation data center facilities operating in the country. Commercial data centers provide the physical infrastructure for hosting cloud services, content delivery, and enterprise applications domestically.
redteam_note: Scored >0 but NO source cited — unsupported claim, verify first.
revision_notes: No source was originally cited. Checked the major pan-African colocation operators (Raxio, Africa Data Centres, Teraco, Liquid); none operate a facility in Guinea-Bissau. Raxio's nearest facility serving the WAEMU bloc (which includes Guinea-Bissau) is in Abidjan, Côte d'Ivoire, confirming no in-country commercial data centre. Marketing pages claiming 'Tier III' hosting in Bissau (e.g. atalnetworks.com, dcdeployed.com) are unverifiable promotional listings, not credible evidence of a real facility, and were disregarded. Score of 1 confirmed, unchanged.

Definition: The maturity of the country's technology startup ecosystem, based on the number of tech startups, venture capital activity, accelerators/incubators, and the presence of a supportive ecosystem. Africa's startup scene is well-documented by trackers like Partech, Disrupt Africa, and Briter Bridges.
Value Name: Nascent (very few tech startups, no visible VC activity)
redteam_note: Scored >0 but NO source cited — unsupported claim, verify first.
revision_notes: No source was originally cited. A 2026 Fintech Times survey found only an estimated 5-15 fintech firms in Guinea-Bissau, no standalone national fintech/startup strategy, and local startup activity described as limited. AU-Startups' Guinea-Bissau country tracker records zero startups and zero investors as of mid-2026, and no funding rounds appear in Disrupt Africa or Partech Africa reporting for the country. Score of 1 (Nascent) confirmed, unchanged.

Contrary to the stated claim of fewer than two institutions, at least two operating universities offer dedicated ICT/computer-engineering degrees: Universidade Lusófona da Guiné-Bissau (Licenciatura em Engenharia Informática) and Universidade Jean Piaget de Guiné-Bissau (undergraduate Computer Engineering), plus a private technology institute (Instituto Superior da Tecnologia e Gestão).
